entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

Hi Sarah... I really hope you can help me. I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I'm pretty sure I'm outside the window, and I feel terrible about it, but things have just been... a mess.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Mark Evans, and the order number is... VF778192.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. So I can understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it. It's still in the box. I just... I bought it for my son. Right after it arrived, we had a major family emergency. My brother was scheduled for surgery, but then his son got sudden orders for a military deployment.
Oh my, that sounds like a very difficult time.

It was. I spent the next few weeks at the hospital helping my sister-in-law, and the VeloBand just got completely forgotten in the chaos. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back for bills. I'm so sorry for waiting this long.
Mark, please don't apologize. It sounds like you had far more important things to focus on. Let me just check the policy for you here... one moment.
Okay, I've got it. It looks like the order was placed 35 days ago. Actually, you have nothing to worry about. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days from the date of delivery.
Wait, 10 days? Are you sure? I thought I saw it was much shorter. Oh, that's... that's a huge relief. Wow. Thank you.

Of course! You are well within the timeframe. I'm processing the return authorization for you right now. I'm sending an email to you with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack it up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
That's fantastic. Sarah, you have no idea how much this helps. Thank you so, so much for being so understanding.
It's my pleasure, Mark. I'm happy I could help sort this out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. You've made my day. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get easier for your family soon.
